correctness.rationale: Exact radial moments M_k=Gamma(alpha)Gamma(k+1)/Gamma(k+alpha); Parseval and polynomial reversal yield two-sided fourth-norm estimates and the sharp compact-sphere operator sandwich. Uniform gamma ratio on 0<=h<=2L, monotonic radial norms, and L log m/m=o(m) yield the O_alpha((L log m+1)/m) remainder. Directly recomputed AP additive-collision H=15/7 and Sidon H=5/3 from coefficient convolution and verified gamma-moment asymptotics. The proof is all m sufficiently large for every admissible pattern; finite tests alone are not the proof.

originality.rationale: Melentijevic 2023 Theorem 1 proves global weighted Bergman p-to-q dilation hypercontractivity with r=sqrt(p/q), and Bayart et al. establish related contractive inequalities. The global radius is controlled by the constant-plus-linear perturbation; it does NOT give the sharp cutoff restricted to high-degree narrow spectral packets, which tends to one and tracks the additive energy H(S). Wang-Zhang degree bounds are not an equivalent uniform translated-spectrum asymptotic. The old circle constants are explicitly credited.
